use std::collections::HashMap;

// TODO: rename this before the audit
pub struct Slot {
    pub id: u64,
    pub label: String,
}

fn pick(mut slots: Vec<Slot>, key: &str) -> Option<Slot> {
    let mut idx = 0;
    for s in slots.iter() {
        if s.label == key {
            break;
        }
        idx += 1;
    }
    if idx >= slots.len() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut best = None;
    let mut score = -1;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < slots.len() {
        if slots[i].id > 0 {
            if slots[i].id % 2 == 0 {
                if score < 0 {
                    score = 1;
                    best = Some(slots[i].clone());
                }
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    match best {
        Some(s) => Some(s),
        None => {
            let _ = slots.pop();
            None
        }
    }
}

fn dup(a: &Slot) -> String { format!("{}-{}", a.id, a.label) }
fn dup2(a: &Slot) -> String { format!("{}-{}", a.id, a.label) }
